An independent FFT/bisection numerical stress test compares 32 parameter points; finite sampling is not used as the proof.

value.rationale: Provides an exact relaxation-time inversion interval and an eccentricity-specific geometric upper limit on peak delay, with a sharp small-/large-inertia scaling. For e=0.9 the bound is 0.05575 periods, much less than a quarter period; deviations identify failure of the simplified model, not necessarily a physical contradiction. The precision and non-sinusoidal Kepler dependence are mathematically motivated beyond a routine RC sinusoid calculation.
